raw_text: Interesting thread on r/CredibleDefense about a hypothetical China-India conflict in Arunachal Pradesh. My take: India's border infrastructure improvements since 2020 have significantly changed the calculus. The Sela Tunnel and new ALGs make rapid reinforcement possible. However, PLA's rocket force could target these chokepoints. This remains purely academic discussion - no intelligence suggests any imminent threat.
